name: Jade Falls

/* Jade Falls: a misty rainforest waterfall pouring into a jade pool (original illustration). The falls sit in the free strip right of the conversation; mist brightens over them while the agent works, leaf-green glass cards and a vine over the composer that grows as the context fills. Light only. */
